summary: Tests cover core requirements (glob matching, priorities, deduplication, config loading) and follow TDD structure with clear step progression. Workflow structure is validated and act end-to-end execution is included. However, significant gaps: the `?` glob character is implemented but untested; complex glob patterns are absent; functions like Convert-GlobToRegex, Import-ChangedFiles, and Invoke-PRLabelAssigner are only tested indirectly; whitespace handling, case sensitivity, and malformed rules edge cases are missing; only 3 end-to-end test cases (no negative scenarios through act). Test organization is clean with good naming and proper BeforeAll setup, but lacks fixture modularity. Would catch most regressions but could miss boundary conditions and error injection scenarios.
